messages:
olivia: FYI ran a 6h perf sweep on cluster-b last night. Short seq tenants are monopolizing GPU cycles via micro-batches, starving long sequences. p99 latency for long jobs jumped ~2.3x.
ryan: Can you paste the top metrics? which kernels are hot?
olivia: Toplines: long-seq p99 went from 120ms -> 280ms, avg throughput down ~18%. Kernel selector kept choosing Fast-Short kernel (fused-attn-v2) for mixed requests because mean-length heuristics bias toward short.
priya: Wait — why would KS pick a short-optimized kernel for a mixed batch? batching heuristics still use mean seq len; that explains it.
zane: Another factor: KV-cache hit imbalance. Short chat tenants have much higher KV-hit ratio so their effective token cost is lower and they occupy more batch slots over time.
emma: I prototyped an "elastic short cap" + token-weighted batching. Config I tested:
```json
{
  "batching": {
    "mode": "token_weighted",
    "batch_token_target": 2048,
    "short_token_cap": 256,
    "short_cap_recovery_s": 30
  },
  "tenant_crediting": {
    "initial_credits": 1024,
    "credit_refill_rate_per_s": 20,
    "aging_half_life_s": 120
  }
}
```
olivia: With that we saw long p99 drop ~15% and far fewer kernel switches (fused-attn-v2 used mainly by pure-short batches). Throughput dip was ~3% on canary.
ryan: Do we have telemetry to detect cross-tenant KV-hit bias? a chart would help for the postmortem.
perf-bot: metrics query -> `rate(requests_total[5m]) by (tenant, seq_len_bucket)` shows short tenants ~3.2x request rate; KV_hit_ratio by tenant available.
perf-bot: Attached graph -> https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/kv-hit-tenant
priya: Two operational questions: 1) fallback when credits depleted? 2) rollback plan if throughput regresses?
olivia: Fallback: roll to mean-binning if long-starvation observed >5m and trigger canary rollback. Rollout controlled via feature-flag in Console (canary->staged->prod).
zane: Suggest adding a kernel-tagging heuristic: if token-weighted batch has >50% tokens from long sequences, set `preferred_kernel=long-optimized` to avoid short-kernel path. This reduces destructive kernel churn.
ryan: Need an experiment matrix before wide rollout: A) token_weighted only, B) token_weighted + short_cap, C) token_weighted + short_cap + kernel_tag. Win criteria: long p99 <= baseline*1.1 AND overall throughput loss <5%.
emma: I can run A and B on canary-gpu pool tomorrow and collect traces, kernel-switch counts, kv-hit per-tenant. Will log configs and attach traces.
olivia: Awesome. Can someone own the KV telemetry dashboard update? @priya?
priya: on it :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for canary-gpu at 03:00 UTC. change: enable token_weighted batching in canary.
olivia: Great. Let's reconvene after a 12h run and review metrics. :rocket:
